completeness.acceptance: Independently inventory all material definitions, procedures, examples, formulas, explanations and qualifications; verify their retention. Unit presence is insufficient.

accuracy_and_source_faithfulness.acceptance: Review every material claim against correct source context and, where needed, independently establish source factual correctness. No unresolved critical semantic defect.

explanation_quality.acceptance: Check prerequisites, why/how, conditions, alternatives and error-to-correction explanations with a subject reviewer.

organization_and_readability.acceptance: Independent reader checks logical progression, readability, terminology and navigation; preserve distinct information.

examples_and_code.acceptance: Check literal provenance separately from behavioral correctness, compilation/execution where appropriate, deliberate-error labels, formulas and missing visuals.

source_traceability.acceptance: Correct canonical source, quoted evidence, version, qualification scope, field binding and final-note retention for every approved claim.

reproducible_sampling_plan.selection: Risk-first plus deterministic SHA-256 uniform-style ordering without replacement over the remaining exact-evidence bundles; not a whole-document accuracy estimate.

sample_results.scope: 24 initially selected exact-evidence bundles only; not a population accuracy estimate.
sample_results.scope_repair_follow_up: Three decisions were invalidated by the mortgage context repair and explicitly reviewed again. Initial sample findings and follow-up are separate records.

critical_census: All 80 known adverse literal-fidelity field records checked for retained source evidence and withholding. This does not certify algorithm correctness.
